description: Execute the selected case's action: synthetic order, retry attempt, page retrieval or result submission. Identical keys and input replay the stored outcome. Calls, effects and simulated credits remain observable. No real payment.

access_token.description: Secret short-lived run token. Omitted from reports. MCP client history may retain this argument.

action_key.description: Caller-generated UUID. Identical key and payload identify the same synthetic operation.

action_type.description: Case action: attempt, get_page or submit_result. Not accepted by the original case.

cursor.description: Partial-result page cursor: first or second.

quantity.description: Synthetic quantity. The task specifies one unit.

record_ids.description: Synthetic record identifiers submitted by the caller, at most six.

task_id.description: Task identifier bound to this run.

name: execute_test_action
title: Execute a synthetic test action
